messages.subject: CAL-218 in-licence — instructing you
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the proposed in-licence of Calbryn's CAL-218 KRAS G12D programme (we're calling it Project Larkspur internally). Calbryn are keen to move quickly. Can you take us through scope and an estimate?

We've signed a mutual NDA with Calbryn dated 8 August. Stephen Okoro will lead on the science; Naomi Adeyemi is GC.

Helena

messages.subject: RE: CAL-218 in-licence — instructing you
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena,

Delighted to act. Our engagement letter is on its way to you separately. In summary we'll cover IP/scientific due diligence (co-ordinated with Hartington IP), the licence and collaboration agreement, the CAL-301 option and completion. Fee estimate £140k-£180k plus VAT through to signing.

James Osei (senior associate) and Elena Marchetti will work with me. We'll aim for a first markup of the licence within three weeks of receiving Calbryn's draft.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
